acceptance.given: After each Stable or Candidate subject execution across all six Matrix Cases, the toolchain records an execution artifact containing the Matrix Case identifier and subject identity.

oracle.expected: A validator confirms every Matrix Case has both Stable and Candidate records with unambiguous case and subject fields.
forbidden: Any execution lacks a Matrix Case or subject attribution.
A record is ambiguous between Stable and Candidate executions.
oracle.observable: Structured execution evidence records and the validator result showing complete bidirectional attribution.

acceptance.then: Attributable evidence exists for all six Matrix Cases and both subject executions in each case.
acceptance.when: The FR-7 evidence validation phase evaluates collected execution records.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an evidence fixture missing a case or subject attribution and require the validator to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that every Stable and Candidate execution artifact is attributable to exactly one Matrix Case and subject.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing evidence schema while rejecting records lacking required attribution.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unattributed execution evidence becomes a validator failure; complete attribution becomes accepted evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds only when all six Matrix Cases have both Stable and Candidate attributed records.

acceptance.given: Evaluation processes an always-success false-negative probe case.

oracle.expected: The evaluation records a failure verdict for the always-success false-negative case.
forbidden: The false-negative case is reported as pass or success.
oracle.observable: Evaluation result artifact with a failing verdict tied to the always-success false-negative case.

acceptance.then: The always-success false-negative evaluation is failed.
acceptance.when: The FR-4 evaluation phase executes the always-success false-negative probe.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the always-success false-negative fixture and assert the evaluator returns a non-success verdict.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Detect an always-success probe whose semantic outcome is false-negative and convert that case into an evaluation failure.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep the existing probe result schema while ensuring false-negative outcomes cannot pass evaluation.

slice_hint.state_transition: An always-success false-negative is observed and becomes a failed evaluation verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The evaluator returns a failure result whenever the always-success false-negative case is encountered.

acceptance.given: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages execute and are verified.

oracle.expected: Isolation checks demonstrate independent mutable state and evidence for each listed entity; mutating one entity does not alter another entity's state or verdict.
forbidden: Shared mutable state or shared evidence causes cross-entity mutation.
One entity's mutation changes another entity's verification outcome.
oracle.observable: Isolation test output showing distinct state/evidence identities and unchanged peer results after mutation.

acceptance.then: Mutable state is isolated across Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages.
acceptance.when: The NFR-4 isolation verification phase runs its state-mutation checks.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an isolation fixture that aliases mutable state or evidence between two listed entities and require the isolation verifier to detect the alias.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce independent state and evidence containers for every listed entity and detect cross-entity mutation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain validator interfaces while adding isolation assertions for state and evidence containers.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aliased mutable state becomes an isolation failure; independent state permits verification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Isolation verification passes only when mutations remain local to the originating entity and evidence identities remain distinct.

acceptance.given: Target resolution cannot find or is not provided with a target package.

oracle.expected: Processing is denied or terminated and no target content is accepted as valid.
forbidden: Processing proceeds with a missing target.
A missing target is accepted or processed as valid.
oracle.observable: Target-resolution validator returns a closed or rejected result for the absent target.

acceptance.then: The missing target is rejected and processing remains closed.
acceptance.when: The FR-1 target resolution phase receives an absent target.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke target resolution with an absent target path and require a closed or rejected result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Fail closed when target resolution receives no target.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the read-only target validation API while rejecting absent target inputs.

slice_hint.state_transition: No target becomes rejected and closed; a valid target follows normal resolution.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Target resolution terminates closed with a rejection outcome whenever the target is missing.
